_note: Spec and credit record of the work-site sounds (WK-W23, #4183): the 06:00/18:00 shift whistle and a quiet tool bed at the mine and the sawmill. build.mjs reads it and writes addons/LF_Everon1989/Sounds/Work/ and its manifest.json. Vanilla was checked first (see vanilla_checked); the gaps are ElevenLabs sound effects. Prompts never name an artist, a song or a label.
vanilla_checked: 2026-11-23: asset_search for 'whistle' finds no vanilla shift or steam whistle, and the vanilla prop loops (generator, tape recorder) play their own events, not SOUND_LF_AMBIENT_LP that LF_AmbientEmitterComponent starts. The pick/shovel/handsaw beds have no vanilla loop of their own either, so all three are generated.

whistle.note: An emitter with slot atmo_shift_whistle and hour window 6 to 6.02 (and a second at 18 to 18.02) sounds once per window; the sample is 5.5 s and at the 2 h day the window is 6 real seconds. The site's place card sets it on its own emitter.

sounds.name: ShiftWhistle
sounds.prompt: Old steam works shift whistle blowing two long blasts with a short pause between them, heard outdoors across a work site. Brass and steam, no voices, no music, no machinery.
